login.title: Log in
login.heading: Log in
login.description: Pick up your agenda where you left it.

methods.googleFailed: Google sign-in did not finish. Try again or continue with email.
methods.passkeyFailed: Passkey sign-in did not finish. Try again or use another method.
methods.passkeyUnsupported: This browser doesn’t support passkeys. Use another method to log in.

login.legal: By logging in you agree to our <terms>Terms of use</terms> and the <privacy>Privacy notice</privacy>.

register.title: Create account
register.promise: Your agenda stops living in your phone.
register.description: Create your account, add your services and share your booking link. Your customers pick a time you really have free, and you stop confirming one appointment at a time.
register.heading: Create your account

methods.googleFailed: Google sign-up did not finish. Try again or continue with email.

register.legal: By creating your account you accept the <terms>Terms of use</terms> and the <privacy>Privacy notice</privacy>.

forgotPassword.title: Reset password
forgotPassword.heading: Reset your password
forgotPassword.description: Tell us the email on the account and we will send a reset link.

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.heading: Choose a new password
resetPassword.description: This link works once. Pick the password you will use from now on.

changePassword.title: Choose your password
changePassword.heading: Choose your own password
changePassword.description: You signed in with a temporary password. Replace it with one only you know before you open your agenda.
changePassword.hint: At least 8 characters, with upper and lowercase letters, a number and a symbol.
changePassword.unexpected: We could not save your password. Try again.

reactivateAccount.title: Reactivate your account
reactivateAccount.heading: Your account is still here
reactivateAccount.description: You can still get it back before it is deleted.
reactivateAccount.scheduled: Hi {{name}}, your account is scheduled to be deleted on {{date}}.

business.kept: If you reactivate it, {{business}} reopens with all its content and your team gets its access back.
business.purged: The content of {{business}} has already been deleted. If you reactivate your account, you get your business back empty: no services, appointments, payments or customers.

reactivateAccount.accountOnly: If you reactivate it, we cancel the deletion and you sign back in as usual.
reactivateAccount.dismissHint: If you choose “Not now”, you can reactivate it the next time you log in, as long as it is before that date.
reactivateAccount.unexpected: We could not reactivate your account. Try again.
reactivateAccount.dismissFailed: We could not close this screen. Try again.

loadFailed.message: We could not load your account details. Check your connection and try again.

twoFactorChallenge.title: Two-step verification
twoFactorChallenge.heading: Confirm it’s you
twoFactorChallenge.body: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
twoFactorChallenge.recoveryBody: Enter one of your recovery codes. Each code works once.

confirmPassword.title: Confirm your password
confirmPassword.heading: Confirm your password
confirmPassword.description: You’re entering a protected area. Enter your password to continue.
